description: `UpdateIdentityProviderPayload` is a `oneOf` discriminated by `type`, mapping `oauth2` to `OAuth2IdentityProviderPatch`, but that schema has no `type` member, so the generated type can't express the discriminator the spec's own mapping requires. Adds it, with the same enum `OAuth2IdentityProvider.type` has. Evidence: the spec's `discriminator.mapping` on `UpdateIdentityProviderPayload`. The request body stays opaque at runtime: nothing else changes.
